تنتبهي (form VIII)
# تَنْتَبِهِي (tantabihī) /tan.ta.bi.hiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَبَهَ (intabaha)
# تُنْتَبَهِي (tuntabahī) /tun.ta.ba.hiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَبَهَ (intabaha)
